name: @activepieces/piece-bookedin
description: AI agents for lead conversion and appointment booking.

auth.description:
To connect your Bookedin account, please follow these steps to retrieve your API Key:

    1. Log in to your Bookedin Dashboard: dashboard.bookedin.ai
    2. From the left menu, go to **Business**
    3. Open **Settings**
    4. Click on **API Key**
    5. Copy your API Key (starts with **sk_…**)
    6. Paste the key below to authorize the integration

    Your API Key allows Activepieces to securely access your Bookedin leads, agents, and booking data.

getLeads.name: getLeads
getLeads.description: Get all leads for the current business with pagination metadata.

search.description: Search text in name, email, or phone number

aiMetadata.description: List leads for the authenticated Bookedin business, returning a page with pagination metadata. Use it to browse or find leads; leave the filter fields empty to fetch all, or narrow by free-text search (name/email/phone), exact email, phone, or source, and page through results with limit/skip. Read-only and idempotent.

createLead.name: createLead
createLead.description: Creates a new lead in Bookedin AI

aiMetadata.description: Create a new lead in Bookedin for the authenticated business from a contact first name, last name, email, and phone (all required). Use it to add a prospect into the lead pipeline. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate lead, with no de-duplication on email or phone.

getLead.name: getLead
getLead.description: Get a specific lead by ID.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single lead by its Bookedin lead ID. Use it to read the full record for one known lead; if you only have a name, email, or phone, find the ID first with Get Leads. Read-only and idempotent.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently delete a lead by its Bookedin lead ID. Use it to remove a known lead from the pipeline; this is destructive and cannot be undone. Idempotent on the end state — once the lead is gone, re-running targets an already-removed record.

getLeadStats.name: getLeadStats
getLeadStats.description: Get lead statistics (Hot, Warm, Cold, Objectives Met, Total).

aiMetadata.description: Get aggregate lead statistics for the authenticated Bookedin business, such as counts of Hot, Warm, and Cold leads, objectives met, and the total. Use it for a quick pipeline summary rather than fetching individual leads. Takes no input; read-only and idempotent.

update_json.description: Optional JSON body for complex updates. Merges with individual fields above.

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing lead identified by its Bookedin lead ID. Supply any of the individual contact fields (first/last name, email, phone) and handling status, and/or pass a raw JSON payload for complex updates that merges over those fields. Use it to edit a known lead; only the fields you provide are changed. Idempotent — re-applying the same values yields the same lead state.

de.To connect your Bookedin account, please:
Um Ihr Bookedin-Konto zu verbinden, folgen Sie bitte diesen Schritten, um Ihren API-Schlüssel abzurufen:

    1. Melden Sie sich im Bookedin Dashboard an: Dashboard. ookedin.ai
    2. Vom linken Menü gehen Sie zu **Business**
    3. Öffne **Einstellungen**
    4. Klicken Sie auf **API Schlüssel**
    5. Kopieren Sie Ihren API-Schlüssel (beginnt mit **sk_…**)
    6. Fügen Sie den folgenden Schlüssel ein, um die Integration

    zu autorisieren und Ihr API-Schlüssel ermöglicht Activepieces den sicheren Zugriff auf Ihre Bookedin Leads, Agenten und Buchungsdaten.

Pour connecter votre compte Bookedin, veuillez suivre ces étapes pour récupérer votre clé API :

    1. Connectez-vous à votre tableau de bord Bookedin: tableau de bord. ookedin.ai
    2. À partir du menu de gauche, allez à **Business**

    4. Cliquez sur **Clé API**

    6. Collez la clé ci-dessous pour autoriser l'intégration

    Votre clé d'API permet à Activepieces d'accéder de manière sécurisée à vos prospects Bookedin, les agents et les données de réservation.

Obtenir un prospect spécifique par ID.

pt.To connect your Bookedin account, please:
Para conectar sua conta do Bookedin, por favor, siga estes passos para recuperar sua chave de API:

    1. Faça login no seu painel do Bookedin : dashboard. ookedin.ai
    2. No menu à esquerda, vá para **Negócios**
    3. Abra **Configurações**
    4. Clique em **Chave de API**
    5. Copie sua chave de API (começa com **sk_…**)
    6. Cole a chave abaixo para autorizar a integração

    Sua chave de API permite que peças ativas acessem de forma segura seus leads do Bookedin agentes e reserva os dados.
